steps.label: public
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && tar xzf ki2_pub.tgz -C ki && ls ki/bundle/public | grep -c __

steps.label: render
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion render ki/bundle P ki_out.mp4 --gl=angle --crf=18 --muted --concurrency=6 --timeout=180000 --log=error

steps.label: mux
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i ki_out.mp4 -i ki/mix2.m4a -map 0:v -map 1:a -c copy -shortest ki_film.mp4 && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i ki_film.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 27 -preset veryfast -vf scale=1280:-2 -c:a copy ki_720.mp4 && ls -l ki_720.mp4 ki_film.mp4 > ki_done.txt
